stem: Carmella plotted the ordered pair (1, 3) on a coordinate grid by moving 1 unit up and 3 units left from the origin. Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: Carmella plotted both the x-coordinate and the y-coordinate incorrectly.

options.label: G
options.text: Carmella plotted the x-coordinate incorrectly and the y-coordinate correctly.

options.label: H
options.text: Carmella plotted the x-coordinate correctly and the y-coordinate incorrectly.

options.label: J
options.text: Carmella plotted both the x-coordinate and the y-coordinate correctly.
